meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Times of India's sign-in pop-up, side gutters and sponsored widgets; blur or hide story pictures
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on timesofindia.indiatimes.com (home, Sri Lanka edition via geo) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text and links stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on #app).

LIVE desktop: `.signup-popup-overlay` 1 (contains #login-popup), `.appgutter` 1, `[id^="taboola"]` 1, `.trc_rbox_container` 1 (Taboola; 12 sponsored items), `.global_img_wrap` 78 (also `.global_story_img` 78), the original ad rule 19 elements (phone 11). LIVE phone: `.global_img_wrap` 375, `.signup-popup-overlay` 1. The original cookie and app-banner rules matched nothing; the consent dialog is not in the DOM here (Funding Choices iframe `googlefcPresent` only).

Choices: Story pictures Show/Blur/Hide.

Site markup mixes readable classes (`global_img_wrap`, `appgutter`) with a React app shell; no hashed classes are used.

NOT verified: article pages (in-article ads, the Times Prime paywall prompt, the related-story rails), the TOI+ pages, the live consent state in the EU, the app-install interstitial on a real phone, other editions.
